spec.name: Furniture Boarded Haunted Window
spec.description: A thin wall-mounted gothic window facade with a stepped arch, weathered crooked boards, dark purple glass, two pale watching eyes and painted cobweb corners. Flat rear at z=15.75; decorated front faces negative Z. No stand.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: wall-mounted gothic fake window facade with dark purple glass, two ominous pale eyes peering out, crooked stepped wooden boards and small cobweb corners; all artwork on a thin panel, no stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Wall attachment: ALL geometry stays in local z=12..15.75, flat rear at positive Z, decorated front facing negative Z. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
